verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a regex/pattern-based secret-detection tool that scans text/diffs for hardcoded credentials; it has no static analysis engine, AST/data-flow model, or cross-file/function taint tracking capability. Taint-style vulnerability detection is a category error for this product type (that's SAST/dataflow tools like Semgrep or CodeQL), so this axis does not apply.
